name: complete-crm-csv-ingestion
description: Schema-driven CRM CSV ingestion with rejected-row evidence for the Complete GCP CRM migration solution.

parameters.name: run_date
parameters.label: Run date
parameters.helpText: Business run date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: source_type
parameters.label: Source type
parameters.helpText: CRM source type, for example crm_sales or crm_support.

parameters.name: input_prefix
parameters.label: Input prefix
parameters.helpText: GCS prefix containing CRM CSV files for the run date.

parameters.name: schema_config_path
parameters.label: Schema config path
parameters.helpText: GCS path to the source schema config JSON.

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.label: Output BigQuery table
parameters.helpText: Output BigQuery table in project:dataset.table format.

parameters.name: rejected_output_prefix
parameters.label: Rejected output prefix
parameters.helpText: GCS prefix where rejected rows are written as JSONL.

parameters.name: audit_table
parameters.label: Audit BigQuery table
parameters.helpText: Audit BigQuery table in project:dataset.table format.
